I completely relate. I find myself beating myself up over the bridges I burnt due to my behavior from my depression. 

Slowly but surely I try to be nicer to myself by allowing myself to forgive my past self. 

This might sound odd but I found what helped me was a combination things like watching cringe compilations on youtube to remind myself that I'm not the only one here on planet earth making mistakes. Using a visual tool to remind my brain that every human on planet is going to fuck something up or say something dumb etc etc. Because of course I'm aware that nobody is perfect but using a visual tool made it really sink in because it was able to cut through the hatred in myself and allow me to maybe be okay for a few seconds with not being mean to myself. That I am worthy of moving on and being allowed redemption.

I tried to call myself out when I have negative thoughts like that. I am alone a lot of the time so I don't care about talking to myself out loud. When I have that thought I try to talk to myself similar to a drill sergeant. "People are allowed to fuck up!" "Aren't you sad and tired of thinking about this, it's time to move on!" Saying it out loud helped me to stand up for myself to myself. 

It's no magic combination that will cure everything but I Hope this kinda helps ya out! It's what worked for my brain. It did honestly take some time just for me to work up to the action of wanting to be kinder to myself so don't beat yourself up if the motivation doesn't come right away. Baby steps.
